limitations: Independent Korean-language review remains pending. These source-backed policy judgments are not a measured precision benchmark.
Four of the 116 native single-ㅎ entries lack a usable written 니 paradigm and remain unknown: 길다랗다, 까놓다, 넓다랗다, 덮어놓다. Missing or pronunciation-only forms never become a regularity claim.
Classification uses written 활용 stem+으니 versus the shortened 니 spelling. Literal consonant endings impose no spelling-class requirement; 놓아→놔 remains a separate regular-class contraction.

The 116-entry source inventory has 46 regular, 66 irregular and 4 unknown dispositions. 땡그랗다 preserves the source POS 동사 and its irregular written paradigm; no POS correction or blanket verb rule is inferred.

Raw candidate components, order and rule IDs are unchanged on the complete comparison set. New optional spelling_paths metadata preserves alternative derivations and component ownership. Sixteen full-JSON snapshots retain old hashes and verify exact old output after removing only this field.

EntryMatch adds optional hieut written-form evidence. Older JSON without these fields stays readable and is retained conservatively; Rust struct literals must initialize the new fields. This is an additive JSON contract, not a database schema change.

The per-entry/lemma assessments summarize alternatives; the overall reading status evaluates complete spelling paths before union, preventing incompatible derivations from borrowing different owners from each other.
Seven source training groups remain recoverable after compatible filtering. Their complete original sentences and the unrelated 못한다→못+하다 mismatch are preserved; no gold or held-out baseline changes.
All 1121 novel removals are independently traced to lexical_spelling conflicts; raw and headword-only candidates are preserved. This is conflict-policy evidence, not contextual sense validation.
Broader ㄷ/ㅅ/ㅂ/르 and other lexical inflection compatibility remains unreviewed under the wider checklist. Historical/dialectal spelling and correction remain outside the modern written scope.

release_performance.method: Three interleaved release CLI runs per version/filter, including startup, dictionary access and JSONL serialization; stdout discarded. Linux per-child peak RSS. Measurements do not establish statistical equivalence.
